meta.name: Fixture Brand
meta._why: A FAKE brand, and the only pack this repo ships. It exists so CI can scaffold a real surface and gate it without the private dh-hub vault, which no runner can see. Every value here is invented; nothing in it belongs to a client. Never use it for anything but the smoke test, and never copy it as the shape of a real pack — a real pack is compiled from live sources with 29 graded capabilities (core/brand-packs/NEW-BRAND-RUNBOOK.md).

brandOnly.role: a BRAND-layer colour outputs.web does not carry, so the smoke test covers TOKENS.brand too

palette._note: Invented values. Six colours is enough to exercise the flattener, the nested group and the luminance measurement.

field.role: the lightest value, so the measured starter ground resolves here

deep.role: the darkest value, so the measured starter ink resolves here. Nested on purpose: this exercises flattenPalette's camelCase join.

fonts._note: Deliberately empty. The scaffold reads no font, so an empty fonts key must not break it.
